title: bug: grantNextLeases passes over a worktree completion's queued git-land lease, because complete_task already cleared the task's assignee
description:
Filed by the governor on 2026-11-03 from a live stall of WT-19 (task-b1ca54f2), the worktree epic's final task.

PROBLEM. A worktree completion takes the git-land-<target> lease at L3, after moe.complete_task has moved the row to REVIEW and cleared assignedWorkerId. If another landing holds the lease, the wrapper queues (acquire_resource, then wait_for_resource). On release, grantNextLeases (packages/moe-daemon/src/state/resourceStore.ts, the pass-over at ~line 449) skips every entry whose task fails heldByLiveSeat (~line 83). heldByLiveSeat returns false for any unassigned task. So the queued completion is never granted:
- it waits out its own wait_for_resource (up to 10 min per wait);
- later landings acquire directly past it;
- under steady traffic it can exhaust MOE_LAND_LEASE_WAIT_SEC (default 1800) and fail as MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_LAND_LEASE, the unlanded route back to a worker.

EVIDENCE. From .moe/activity.log, 2026-11-03, git-land-moe-work-2026-10-24:
- 13:54:56Z RESOURCE_ACQUIRED task-1765335a (worker-ed0f6a9e).
- 13:55:17Z RESOURCE_QUEUED task-b1ca54f2 (worker-8cf0816c). WT-19 is REVIEW with no assignee: complete_task ran at 13:54:54Z.
- 13:55:24Z RESOURCE_RELEASED task-1765335a. No grant follows.
- 13:57:37Z RESOURCE_ACQUIRED task-13ff6bb4 (direct, past the queued WT-19).
- 13:58:01Z RESOURCE_RELEASED task-13ff6bb4. Still no grant.
- At 14:04Z, list_resources showed holders [] and queue [task-b1ca54f2, position 1]. The wrapper was still parked in wait_for_resource.

FIX DIRECTION (verify against the code first).
- A queue entry is held for grant purposes when either:
  - the task's assignee is a live seat bound to it (as today); or
  - the entry's own workerId is a registered, non-DEAD seat that owns the task's open execution attempt in `finalizing`. That is the post-complete_task landing window, the one moe.finalize_attempt closes.
- Keep the pass-over for rows nobody can use, so resourceStore.unheld.test.ts stays meaningful.
- Assumption to check: which attempt-store accessor exposes an attempt's status and its owning worker.

Files expected: packages/moe-daemon/src/state/resourceStore.ts plus a test (a resourceStore*.test.ts file or a new one). Not held by any open row at filing time.
definitionOfDone: When a task in REVIEW has an open finalizing attempt owned by a live seat, and that seat's git-land queue entry comes up, grantNextLeases grants it as capacity frees and logs RESOURCE_GRANTED. A regression test replays the 13:55Z sequence: A holds the lease; B completes, so it is unassigned with a finalizing attempt, and queues; A releases; B is granted.

Rows no live seat can use are still passed over: unassigned with no finalizing attempt, a DEAD or deregistered requester, or an attempt owned by another seat. The existing resourceStore tests (unheld, lifecycle, deregister, durability) stay green.

The daemon's resourceStore test files and its full npm test pass in a git archive or clone snapshot outside the shared checkout (global rail), with error handling for a missing or unreadable attempt record that falls back to today's pass-over.
